name: Magical Bunny
source:
Shimamura Yuji has been dating Shizuka Kasai for three months now. At the end of today's date she dragged them into a game center where the receptionist is a bunny girl. Shizuka-chan disappears and the "bunny" says that Shimamura has to play a game in order to help her. And so the traveling into the mysterious game world begins.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-october-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
岛村雄二与葛西静香交往三个月了。今天约会结束时，她把他们拖进了一个游戏中心，接待员是一个兔女郎。小静香消失了，“兔子”说岛村必须玩游戏才能帮助她。就这样，进入神秘的游戏世界的旅程开始了。

[编辑自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-october-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
